text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, the first race of the Triple
Tiara,
takes place under the whimsical
fragrance of
cherry blossoms in full
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Seeking the Pearl is more than
excited for
this race. We're walking
along an avenue lined
with cherry
blossom trees that leads to the venue

when she turns to me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Oka Sho, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's race day, and we're walking to it this
very
second. Could something have
happened?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I've changed my mind or
anything,
but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I just have this strange feeling... like I'm
not going
to run in it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I guess I am...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something seems to be bothering her,
but I don't
know what's causing her
discomfort.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I've got this! I have to show
everyone how
strong I am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not acting like herself, and I find
myself
growing a little worried about
her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's something I want to
confirm in
today's Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need to find my ideal race distance!
This is
paramount if I want to continue
pursuing all the
possibilities at my
fingertips!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right! Running 1,600 meters isn't a
problem at
all.
choice_data_list: The mile is a strong contender, right?
The mile is a strong contender, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But if this is the perfect distance for me,
I might
not fare so well in the second
race of the Triple
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After all, the Japanese Oaks is 2,400
meters
long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is right. 1,600-meter
races and
2,400-meter races are two
completely different
beasts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If the Oka Sho is the ideal distance for
her, we
may have to put some thought
into how we
should prepare her for her
next race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, off I go to discover more of my

possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And grasp the answer to what my future
holds!
